req.title: Redirect-to accepts POST as well
req.statement: The system shall accept POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, and TRACE on /redirect-to.

doc.reasoning: The redirect_to handler at /redirect-to accepts GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, and TRACE. The requirement specifically calls out that POST (and other non-GET methods) must be accepted. Tests cover: (1) each allowed HTTP method returns a 3xx redirect with correct Location header (EP/positive), (2) disallowed methods return 405 (NEG/negative), (3) boundary status_code values at 300, 399, 299, 400 to catch off-by-one mutations in the status_code range check (BVA/boundary), (4) decision table covering method × status_code combinations (DT), and (5) state transition from default 302 to custom status code (STC).

tests.name: test_redirect_to_post_returns_302_with_location
actions: POST /redirect-to with url=https://example.com in form data
trace: R-HTTPBIN-028: POST must be accepted on /redirect-to
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_post_returns_302_with_location():
    r = client.post('/redirect-to', data={'url': 'https://example.com'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == 'https://example.com'

test_redirect_to_post_returns_302_with_location()

tests.name: test_redirect_to_all_methods_return_3xx
preconditions: All five non-GET methods are in the allowed list
actions: Send POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH each to /redirect-to with url param
expected: All four responses have correct Location header
trace: R-HTTPBIN-028: decision table — all listed methods must produce 3xx redirect
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_all_methods_return_3xx():
    target = 'https://multi.example.com'
    methods_and_senders = [
        ('POST', lambda u: client.post(u, data={'url': target})),
        ('PUT', lambda u: client.put(u + '?url=' + target)),
        ('DELETE', lambda u: client.delete(u + '?url=' + target)),
        ('PATCH', lambda u: client.patch(u + '?url=' + target)),
    ]
    for method, sender in methods_and_senders:
        r = sender('/redirect-to')
        assert r.status_code == 302, f'{method} expected 302 got {r.status_code}'
        assert r.headers['Location'] == target, f'{method} bad Location'

test_redirect_to_all_methods_return_3xx()
